nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 周四晚上。你按 Oliver 说的，来到书店拐角那家亮着暖黄灯光的老酒馆。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 推门进去，人声鼎沸。角落一张桌子上，Oliver 正朝你使劲挥手。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: There you are! Sit, sit. Our team name is 'The Overdue Books'. Don't ask.

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Rules are simple: they ask, we argue, someone writes an answer, we lose. Ready?

options.text: 「Let's win this time.」（今晚一定要赢）
「I'm rubbish at trivia…」（我不太会答题）

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: That's the spirit! Careful though - confidence is exactly how we lost by forty points last week.

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Relax. Nobody's good at this. We come for the crisps and the arguing. Answers are a bonus.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 主持人敲了敲话筒：『Question one — which London Underground line is the oldest?』

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Oh, I know this one! It's the Metropolitan line. Opened 1863. Trust me, I read it on a coaster.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 你飞快写下答案。几分钟后，主持人公布：『The Metropolitan line — correct!』你们桌爆发出一阵欢呼。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Oi, a good coaster is a primary source. And look - I was right! Ye of little faith.

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: See? Told you. The trick to London is knowing useless things with total confidence.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 一轮轮题目过去，你们从垫底一路追到中游。Oliver 越战越勇，还悄悄教了你几个英式俚语。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: 'Chuffed' means dead happy. 'Knackered' means shattered. You'll sound like a local in no time.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 最后一题揭晓，你们以两分之差错失第一。全桌哀嚎，Oliver 却笑得像个孩子。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Second place! That's basically a trophy for us. We're normally last by teatime.

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Absolutely. You're an official Overdue Book now. There's no escaping us.

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Any time, mate. This city's a lot warmer with someone to lose quizzes beside.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 走出酒馆，夜风微凉。你忽然觉得，这座巨大而陌生的城市，好像有了一个可以停靠的角落。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 【获得 120 金币】你和 Oliver 的友谊，又深了一层。
